title: Andrew Finds His Brother
book: The New Testament, January 2027 (Come and See!)
p1: Andrew had spent the whole day with Jesus. His heart was too full to keep it inside. The first thing he did was find his brother, Simon.
Andrew said, “We have found the Messiah!” That was the Savior Heavenly Father had promised to send. Everyone had been waiting for Him.
Andrew did not just tell Simon. He brought Simon to Jesus, so Simon could meet Him too.
p2: Jesus looked at Simon and said, “You are Simon. You will be called Cephas.” Cephas means a stone, like a big, strong rock. We know him as Peter.
Jesus could see that Simon would grow strong and steady, like a rock. When you find something wonderful, share it! Tonight, think of someone you can tell about Jesus.
note: Rewritten the picture-book way and rated 9-10 by a reviewer that did not write it (29 Oct 2026).
